heṭheti.g: kammassakatāya yathābhūtāvabodhassa ca5 abhāvato ajjhupekkhanaṁ akatvā lobhavasena yathā jano janaṁ assito, evaṁ dosavasena jano janena heṭhīyati vibādhīyati.

heṭhayitvā.l: Janaṁ ohāya gacchaṁ taṁ, heṭhayitvā bahuṁ janan
heṭhayitvā.g: yasmā saṁsāre carato janassa ayamevānurūpā7 paṭipatti, tasmā taṁ janaṁ, tassa ca bādhikā yā sā taṇhā ca, yo ca so doso eva bahuṁ janaṁ bādhayitvā ṭhito8, tañca ohāya sabbaso pahāya pariccajitvā gacchaṁ, tehi1 anupaddutaṁ ṭhānaṁ gaccheyyaṁ pāpuṇeyyanti attho.

heṭhetī.g: idaṁ Satthā Jetavane viharanto Devadattassa vadhāya parisakkanaṁ ārabbha kathesi.
